skills.name: Scarred Fury
skills.description: Heracles records all DMG taken, up to a maximum of 80% of his Max HP. Upon release, he deals DMG equal to 20% of his max HP +100% of the recorded DMG to enemies within 3 meters.

upgrades.level2: Grants a shield equal to 30% of the recorded DMG when cast.
upgrades.level4: Grants a shield equal to 50% of the recorded DMG when cast. (Unlocks at Lv.221)

skills.name: Worldshaker
skills.description: Suppresses an enemy, picks them up, and slams them into an enemy-clustered area, dealing AoE DMG equal to 10% of the suppressed target's max HP (up to 20% of his max HP) to enemies within 3 meters.

upgrades.level2: Deals DMG equal to 15% of the target's max HP, up to 30% of Heracles's max HP.
upgrades.level3: Also knocks down units hit. (Unlocks at Lv.161)
upgrades.level4: Deals DMG equal to 20% of the target's max HP, up to 40% of Heracles's max HP. (Unlocks at Lv.241)

skills.name: Savage Smash
skills.description: After a brief charge, slams the ground, dealing DMG equal to 200% of ATK to enemies in a cone and knocking them down.

upgrades.level2: Gains a shield equal to 10% of the max HP.
upgrades.level3: Deals extra DMG equal to 10% of his max HP. (Unlocks at Lv.201)
upgrades.level4: Restores 5% max HP for each enemy hit. (Unlocks at Lv.281)

skills.name: Godhood Ascension
skills.description: Upon entering the battlefield, Heracles increases his max HP by 10% and converts 5% of his ATK to 2.5% max HP every second.

upgrades.level2: Gains a shield equal to 20% of max HP when ATK drops to 0.
upgrades.level3: Increases max HP to 15%. (Unlocks at Lv.181)
upgrades.level4: Converts 5% of ATK to 5% of max HP every sec. (Unlocks at Lv.261)

relic.name: Defiant Roar
relic.description: Before falling, becomes immune to lethal DMG and instantly restores 50% of max HP. For the next 5s, reduces DMG taken by 50%. Can only trigger once per battle.

upgrades.level2: Restores 100% of max HP. (Unlock at Relic Lv.10)
upgrades.level3: Restores Energy to full when triggered. (Unlock at Relic Lv.20)
upgrades.level4: Reduces DMG taken by 100% for 5s. (Unlock at Relic Lv.30)

pve.label: Basic
pve.description: Formation not fixed. Heracles can run with any 4 supports. Budget entry point due to wide availability outside rate-up banners.

pve.label: Finisher
pve.description: Eris's execute ability perfectly covers Heracles's weakness after two hammers, eliminating low-HP targets he cannot finish.

pve.label: Dual Core
pve.description: Heracles provides crowd control and acts as meat shield. Zeus, Nuba, Cashien and Mengpo stack buffs and energy to maximize Heracles's output.

pve.label: Corpse Explosion
pve.description: Mainly targets Treant. Requires Heracles double hammer simultaneously with Jormungandr explosion for maximum burst.

pve.label: Corpse Explosion Advanced
pve.description: Heracles double hammer + Jormungandr explosion + Nut's energy bullet = total annihilation. Destroys Treant and beyond.

coreMechanic.summary: Hard carry: pull-group then two-burst damage pattern. Second burst arrives before enemy can recover. CN and Excel fully aligned T0. Avoid vs Pan (energy drain counters both bursts).

relicBreakpoints.effect: Early DPS baseline established. First and second burst both functional.
Second burst timing tightens; grouping range increases. Main stopping point.

synergyLinks.description: Athena attack speed buff amplifies Hercules judgment window output.
Poseidon groups; Hercules bursts the cluster. Cross-faction but highly effective.
